Maya: Heads-up — need alignment on the joint announcement + marketplace listing for KeySafe HSM integration (SSO/SAML, SCIM, KMS). Partner requested an embargo until 2025-11-12 08:00 PST. Can we confirm technical readiness and press timeline?

Carlos: Pinged partner PM. They want a dry-run for SAML metadata exchange on 2025-11-08. Who owns the cert rotation doc and metadata endpoint? @Priya? :eyes:

Priya: I can own SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning tests. Suggest we run SCIM sync against their nightly sandbox first. Need partner SCIM base URL + test creds. I'll draft test cases. :white_check_mark:

Jasper: I can run the KMS/HSM acceptance tests. Need partner to provide HSM endpoint + test wrapping key and signing cert. ETA to start: Wed. Will post test vectors here.

Jasper: Example SCIM smoke curl (will share full script after partner creds):
```bash
curl -u scim_test:SECRET_TOKEN -X GET 'https://sandbox.keysafe.example.com/scim/v2/Users' 
```

MarketBot: Marketplace checklist updated by @MarketTeam. Listing ID 9124 requires: security attestation, HSM vendor ID, SCIM provisioning screenshots, SAML metadata XML, and a joint press asset. SLA page draft linked in the console.

Maya: Plan proposal — finalize tech checklist by Monday 2025-11-10 EOD, legal & PR sign-off by 2025-11-11 18:00 PST, embargo lift 2025-11-12 08:00 PST. Internal comms at 07:30, customer-facing note at 09:00. Canary rollout for Dedicated customers for first 48 hours. Thoughts?

Priya: Sounds good. I'll spin up the SCIM delta test and add rollback steps if provisioning fails (fallback to manual invites). Also adding a small quick-run guide for SEs.

Carlos: I've looped in Legal for the joint release language — requested approval with redlines by Tue EOD. Sales ops requested a 24h heads-up window before public announcement.

Jasper: Once I have the HSM endpoint, I'll run keywrap tests and upload logs to the partnership drive. Also planning a small regression test to ensure token encryption/decryption with our KMS SDK.

Maya: Awesome — quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. Agenda: SAML/SCIM test status, KMS/HSM smoke, marketplace listing checks, PR draft approval. I'll send invite and attach the tech checklist. Thanks! :rocket:
